The sign appears warped and melted, with the text 'RUE...' visible but distorted and partially illegible due to the structural deformation. There is no vertical post; the sign is affixed directly to the wall surface.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The rigid sign panel exhibits severe physical impossibility, appearing to melt, warp, and curl like soft fabric or liquid. This is a catastrophic structural failure for a rigid object.
The characters are distorted, merged, and lack consistent kerning or font structure, rendering them largely illegible and nonsensical.
The right side of the sign curls upward and inward in a way that defies the physics of a mounted metal/plastic sheet, indicating a collapse of structural integrity.
The perspective of the sign does not align cleanly with the planar surface of the brick wall behind it, creating a slight floating or pasted-on appearance exacerbated by the warping.
